title: NCAA: Mangubat delivers anew as JRU outlasts Saint Benilde in thriller
summary: It was the Lawrence Mangubat show once again as Jose Rizal University outlasted College of Saint Benilde, 73-69, in NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball on Tuesday at the FilOil Centre in San Juan.
